name: Cyber-Sicherheitsstrategie für Deutschland 2016
owner: Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat
description: Cyber-Sicherheitsstrategie für Deutschland 2016 (adopted November 9, 2016). Whole-of-government Cyber Security Strategy for Germany adopted by the Federal Cabinet on a five-year cycle (2011, 2016, 2021) defining strategic action areas across digital sovereignty, critical infrastructure protection, BSI empowerment, active cyber defence, and European/international cyber policy.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat (bmi.bund.de) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat (bmi.bund.de).
